EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Baidu Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results BEIJING, China, November 16, 2026 – Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ: BIDU and HKEX: 9888 (HKD Counter) and 89888 (RMB Counter)), (“Baidu” or the
“Company”), a leading AI company with strong Internet foundation, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “Our long-term investments in full-stack AI are translating into meaningful growth at scale. This quarter, AI Cloud Infra emerged as a major driver of
Baidu General Business revenue expansion, and Baidu Core AI-powered Business 1 accounted for 53% of Baidu General Business revenue, further reinforcing
AI’s position at the core of our business. We also continued to expand use cases, strengthen capabilities, and improve user experience across our AI applications portfolio,” said Robin Li, Co-founder and CEO of Baidu. “We are pleased to see our AI-first strategy yielding tangible results even as we navigate headwinds in online marketing. AI is
playing an increasingly important role in shaping Baidu’s future, and we remain committed to investing decisively to capture long-term growth opportunities and solidify our competitive edge.” “In Q3, Baidu General Business revenue returned to year-over-year growth, increasing by 1%. AI Cloud Infra revenue 1 grew 94% year over year, helping to partially offset weakness in online marketing and supporting the overall top-line recovery. AI Cloud Infra is becoming a
new growth engine for Baidu, with an increasing contribution to both revenue and profit. Operating cash flow for Baidu also remained positive in the third quarter, reaching RMB 2.8 billion, underscoring our solid cash generation and financial
health,” said Haijian He, CFO of Baidu. “We will maintain a disciplined approach to capital allocation with a clear focus on investment returns as we continue to invest in AI. “ Operational Highlights 1 Corporate • In September 2026, Baidu’s autonomous ride-hailing service, Apollo Go, was selected as a
“Representative Case of Sustainable Overseas Operations by Chinese Enterprises in 2026” by the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) and the Listed Companies Association of China, recognizing its green, safe, and intelligent autonomous
ride-hailing services. 1 The revenue and operational data presented are derived from the Company’s internal management accounts
and records. While prepared in good faith, these internal accounts have not been audited and actual results may differ materially. 1 • Baidu has returned US$373 million to shareholders since the beginning of Q1 2026 through repurchases of its
shares under the current share repurchase program. • In November 2026, Baidu unveiled ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, the latest foundation model in its ERNIE family. The
model delivers strong coding and agentic capabilities, supporting complex workflows and producing usable, high-quality outputs across knowledge work, video creation, game development and 3D modeling. On the latest Code Arena WebDev leaderboard, it
ranks second among open-source models globally. • At Baidu World 2026 in November, Baidu introduced Token Exchange, a neutral, transparent and trusted marketplace
connecting AI model service providers with customers. • In February 2026, Baidu announced the adoption, for the first time, of a dividend policy for its ordinary shares.
The Company expects to declare the first payment of dividend before the end of 2026, subject to Board approval and prevailing market conditions. Baidu Core AI-powered Business AI
Cloud Infra • Revenue from AI Cloud Infra was RMB 8.2 billion in the third quarter of 2026, up 94% year over year. Within
AI Cloud Infra, revenue from GPU Cloud 2 increased by 191% year over year and 43% quarter over quarter in the third quarter of 2026. • In the third quarter of 2026, AI Cloud Infra continued to experience strong demand, with a more diversified
customer base, increased customer prepayments, and a continued shift toward longer-term contracts. • Revenue from external customers’ token usage on Baidu’s Qianfan MaaS platform increased by 1,159%
year over year in the third quarter of 2026. • In July 2026, Kunlunxin M100 was publicly displayed for the first time during the World Artificial Intelligence
Conference. Optimized for large-scale AI inference, M100 is expected to be ready for volume production by the end of 2026. AI Applications • Revenue from AI Applications was RMB 2.6 billion in the third quarter of 2026, approximately flat year over
year. • In the third quarter of 2026, Baidu continued to enhance DuMate, its general work agent, by integrating
capabilities from its internal workplace AI agent dodo, AI coding assistant Comate, and vibe coding platform Miaoda to support a broader range of tasks through a single agent. 2 Revenue from GPU Cloud was previously referred to as subscription-based revenue from AI accelerator
infrastructure. The growth in GPU Cloud Revenue reflected mounting demand for public cloud-based AI computing. 2 • In September 2026, AI DAU penetration across Baidu Wenku and Baidu Drive increased by 60.7% year over year,
reflecting broader adoption of their AI-powered features. • In November 2026, Baidu launched Famou Agent 3.0, its self-evolving agent designed to help enterprises solve
complex operational problems, at Baidu World 2026. • In the third quarter of 2026, production costs for Baidu Yijing hyper-realistic digital humans decreased by
approximately 80% compared with the fourth quarter of 2025. Robotaxi • Apollo Go continued to make meaningful progress across key markets. In Shenzhen, now one of Apollo Go’s
largest markets, fully driverless operational rides increased by approximately 170% quarter over quarter. In Dubai, Apollo Go expanded its fully driverless commercial operations, broadening its operating area and doubling its fleet size. In London,
Apollo Go continued open-road testing in partnership with Uber and Lyft, progressively expanding its testing areas. In Hong Kong, Apollo Go continued fully driverless testing on Airport Island. • As of October 2026, Apollo Go’s global footprint has reached 30 cities. In the third quarter of 2026,
Apollo Go fleets accumulated approximately 34 million autonomous kilometers. As of October 31, 2026, Apollo Go fleet has accumulated more than 390 million autonomous kilometers, while maintaining an outstanding safety record. • In October 2026, Apollo Go received the Consumer Service Award at the Self-Driving Industry Awards (SDIA) in the
UK, recognizing its global operating experience and track record of delivering fully driverless rides at a world-leading scale. AI-native Marketing Services • Revenue from AI-native marketing services was RMB 2.4 billion in the
third quarter of 2026, down 15% year over year. The decline was primarily due to a challenging macroeconomic environment, evolving competitive dynamics, and our strategic decision to prioritize user experience over near-term monetization at this
stage of our AI Search transformation. • Baidu App’s MAUs reached 604 million in September 2026. 3 The following table sets forth selected revenue highlights for our Baidu Core AI-powered Business for the periods indicated: (In billions) Q3 2025 Q2 2026 Q3 2026 YoY QoQ RMB RMB RMB Baidu Core AI-powered Business 1 9.6 12.5 13.2 37 % 6 % - AI Cloud Infra 4.2 7.3 8.2 94 % 11 % - AI Applications 2.6 2.5 2.6 0 % 1 % - AI-native Marketing Services 2.8 2.6 2.4 (15 %) (7 %) % of Baidu General Business 39 % 50 % 53 % Legacy Business 1 12.5 10.4 9.4 (24 %) (10 %) Others 1 2.6 2.3 2.4 (7 %) 5 % Baidu General Business 24.7 25.2 25.0 1 % (1 %) Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results for Baidu 3 , 4 Financial highlights The following table sets forth revenue highlights for Baidu General Business: (In billions, unaudited) Q3 2025 Q2 2026 Q3 2026 YoY QoQ RMB RMB RMB Online Marketing Services 15.3 13.1 11.9 (22 %) (9 %) Online Marketing Services % of Baidu General Business 62 % 52 % 48 % Others 9.4 12.1 13.1 40 % 8 % Others % of Baidu General Business 38 % 48 % 52 % Baidu General Business 24.7 25.2 25.0 1 % (1 %) Revenue was RMB30.8 billion ($4.60 billion), decreasing 1% year over year and 2% quarter over quarter. Selling, general and administrative expenses were RMB5.5 billion ($815 million), decreasing 17% year over year, primarily due to decreases in
expected credit loss expenses and channel spending expenses, and increasing 19% quarter over quarter, primarily due to an increase in expected credit loss expenses. Research and development expenses were RMB4.8 billion ($720 million), decreasing 7% year over year and increasing 5% quarter over quarter. Operating income was RMB626 million ($93 million) and operating margin was 2%. Non-GAAP operating income was RMB1.7 billion ($255 million) and non-GAAP operating margin was 6%. Total other income, net was RMB1.2 billion ($175 million), compared to RMB1.9 billion for the same period last year and RMB184 million
last quarter. The year over year decrease was primarily due to decreases in pickup of earnings from equity method investments and fair value gain from long-term investments, and an increase in net foreign exchange loss arising from exchange rate
fluctuation between Renminbi and U.S. dollar, partially offset by a shift from fair value loss to fair value gain on exchangeable bonds. The quarter over quarter increase was primarily due to a shift from fair value loss to fair value gain on
trading debt investments. Income tax expense was RMB427 million ($64 million), compared to income tax benefit of RMB1.8 billion for the
same period last year and income tax expense of RMB1.0 billion last quarter. Net income attributable to Baidu was RMB1.4 billion ($208
million), net margin for Baidu was 5% and diluted earnings per ADS was RMB4.35 ($0.65). Non-GAAP net income attributable to Baidu was RMB2.4 billion ($357 million), non-GAAP net margin for Baidu was 8% and non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS was RMB6.78 ($1.01). Adjusted EBITDA was RMB4.5 billion ($670 million) and adjusted EBITDA margin was 15%. 5 We define total cash and investments as cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, short-term investments,
net, long-term time deposits and held-to-maturity investments, and adjusted long-term investments. As of September 30, 2026, t otal cash and
investments were RMB276.6 billion ($41.25 billion). Operating cash flow was RMB2.8 billion ($414 million). For detailed financial
information of Baidu General Business and iQIYI, please see the appended financial tables. Non-GAAP Financial Measures To supplement Baidu’s consolidated financial results presented in accordance with GAAP, Baidu uses the following non-GAAP financial measures: non-GAAP operating income, non-GAAP operating margin, non-GAAP net income attributable to Baidu, non-GAAP net margin, non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted
EBITDA margin, adjusted long-term investments and free cash flow. The presentation of these non-GAAP financial measures is not intended to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the financial
information prepared and presented in accordance with GAAP. 7 Baidu believes that these non-GAAP financial measures provide
meaningful supplemental information regarding its performance and liquidity by excluding certain items that may not be indicative of its recurring core business operating results, such as operating performance excluding non-cash charges or non-operating in nature. The Company believes that both management and investors benefit from referring to these non-GAAP financial measures in assessing its performance and when planning and forecasting future periods. These non-GAAP financial measures also facilitate
management’s internal comparisons to Baidu’s historical performance and liquidity. The Company believes these non-GAAP financial measures are useful to investors in allowing for greater
transparency with respect to supplemental information used by management in its financial and operational decision making. A limitation of using these non-GAAP financial measures is that these non-GAAP measures exclude certain items that have been and will continue to be for the foreseeable future a significant component in the Company’s results of operations. These non-GAAP financial measures presented here may not be comparable to similarly titled measures presented by other companies. Other companies may calculate similarly titled measures differently, limiting their
usefulness as comparative measures to the Company’s data. Non-GAAP operating income represents operating
income excluding share-based compensation expenses, amortization and impairment of intangible assets resulting from business combinations, and impairment of long-lived assets. Non-GAAP net income attributable to Baidu represents net income attributable to Baidu excluding share-based
compensation expenses, amortization and impairment of intangible assets resulting from business combinations, impairment of long-lived assets, disposal gain or loss, impairment of long-term investments, and fair value gain or loss of long-term
investments and exchangeable bonds, adjusted for related income tax effects. Baidu’s share of equity method investments for these non-GAAP reconciling items, amortization and impairment of intangible
assets not on the investees’ books, accretion of their redeemable non-controlling interests, the gain or loss associated with the issuance of shares by the investees at a price higher or lower than the
carrying value per share, and penalty imposed by administrative authorities, adjusted for related income tax effects, are also excluded. 8 Non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS represents diluted earnings per
ADS calculated by dividing non-GAAP net income attributable to Baidu, by the weighted average number of ordinary shares expressed in ADS. Adjusted EBITDA represents non-GAAP operating income excluding depreciation of fixed assets, and amortization of finance lease right-of-use assets and
intangible assets excluding those resulting from business combinations. Adjusted long-term investments represent long-term investments, net, with publicly listed equity method investments adjusted to fair value based on quoted market prices. tables: In September 2026, Baidu’s autonomous ride-hailing service, Apollo Go, was selected as a “Representative Case of Sustainable Overseas Operations by Chinese Enterprises in 2026” by the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) and the Listed Companies Association of China, recognizing its green, safe, and intelligent autonomous ride-hailing services.

Baidu has returned US$373 million to shareholders since the beginning of Q1 2026 through repurchases of its shares under the current share repurchase program.

In November 2026, Baidu unveiled ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, the latest foundation model in its ERNIE family. The model delivers strong coding and agentic capabilities, supporting complex workflows and producing usable, high-quality outputs across knowledge work, video creation, game development and 3D modeling. On the latest Code Arena WebDev leaderboard, it ranks second among open-source models globally.
At Baidu World 2026 in November, Baidu introduced Token Exchange, a neutral, transparent and trusted marketplace connecting AI model service providers with customers.

In February 2026, Baidu announced the adoption, for the first time, of a dividend policy for its ordinary shares. The Company expects to declare the first payment of dividend before the end of 2026, subject to Board approval and prevailing market conditions.

Revenue from AI Cloud Infra was RMB 8.2 billion in the third quarter of 2026, up 94% year over year. Within AI Cloud Infra, revenue from GPU Cloud 2 increased by 191% year over year and 43% quarter over quarter in the third quarter of 2026.

In the third quarter of 2026, AI Cloud Infra continued to experience strong demand, with a more diversified customer base, increased customer prepayments, and a continued shift toward longer-term contracts.
Revenue from external customers’ token usage on Baidu’s Qianfan MaaS platform increased by 1,159% year over year in the third quarter of 2026.

In July 2026, Kunlunxin M100 was publicly displayed for the first time during the World Artificial Intelligence Conference. Optimized for large-scale AI inference, M100 is expected to be ready for volume production by the end of 2026.
Revenue from AI Applications was RMB 2.6 billion in the third quarter of 2026, approximately flat year over year.

In the third quarter of 2026, Baidu continued to enhance DuMate, its general work agent, by integrating capabilities from its internal workplace AI agent dodo, AI coding assistant Comate, and vibe coding platform Miaoda to support a broader range of tasks through a single agent.

Revenue from GPU Cloud was previously referred to as subscription-based revenue from AI accelerator infrastructure. The growth in GPU Cloud Revenue reflected mounting demand for public cloud-based AI computing.
In September 2026, AI DAU penetration across Baidu Wenku and Baidu Drive increased by 60.7% year over year, reflecting broader adoption of their AI-powered features.
In November 2026, Baidu launched Famou Agent 3.0, its self-evolving agent designed to help enterprises solve complex operational problems, at Baidu World 2026.
In the third quarter of 2026, production costs for Baidu Yijing hyper-realistic digital humans decreased by approximately 80% compared with the fourth quarter of 2025.

Apollo Go continued to make meaningful progress across key markets. In Shenzhen, now one of Apollo Go’s largest markets, fully driverless operational rides increased by approximately 170% quarter over quarter. In Dubai, Apollo Go expanded its fully driverless commercial operations, broadening its operating area and doubling its fleet size. In London, Apollo Go continued open-road testing in partnership with Uber and Lyft, progressively expanding its testing areas. In Hong Kong, Apollo Go continued fully driverless testing on Airport Island.

As of October 2026, Apollo Go’s global footprint has reached 30 cities. In the third quarter of 2026, Apollo Go fleets accumulated approximately 34 million autonomous kilometers. As of October 31, 2026, Apollo Go fleet has accumulated more than 390 million autonomous kilometers, while maintaining an outstanding safety record.

In October 2026, Apollo Go received the Consumer Service Award at the Self-Driving Industry Awards (SDIA) in the UK, recognizing its global operating experience and track record of delivering fully driverless rides at a world-leading scale.

Revenue from AI-native marketing services was RMB 2.4 billion in the third quarter of 2026, down 15% year over year. The decline was primarily due to a challenging macroeconomic environment, evolving competitive dynamics, and our strategic decision to prioritize user experience over near-term monetization at this stage of our AI Search transformation.
Baidu App’s MAUs reached 604 million in September 2026.
